source_prompt:
Create a PRODUCTION GAME SPRITE SOURCE ATLAS for EMBERDELVE.
The attached image is the established Kindler/Warden palette/cluster style
REFERENCE ONLY. Do NOT copy its people. Make the FOUR NEW characters below.

STRICT LAYOUT: EXACTLY FOUR ROWS and FOUR COLUMNS, 16 isolated full-body
sprites on real TRANSPARENT alpha. Row order below is mandatory.
Each row is one consistent character/costume/scale repeated in four poses:
column 1 ready idle, column 2 subtle breathing idle, column 3 walking left leg
forward, column 4 walking right leg forward. Walk poses genuinely differ.
VERY WIDE transparent gutters between all rows and columns. Full body and feet
inside each cell. No captions, letters, grid, ground, shadows, spark particles,
scenery, stray texture or borders. View is side-three-quarter facing RIGHT.

Art: actual coarse low-resolution pixel game sprites, intended NATIVE 32x40.
Visible BIG SQUARE PIXELS, broad contiguous 3-6-native-pixel colour planes,
two-tone shading and crisp stepped outlines. 12-16 colours per character.
Five-head-high proportions, not giant bobbleheads. No photographic texture,
dither, fine stippling, gradients or smooth vector curves. Midtone planes
against dark outline so figure reads on a charcoal game screen.

RIGGABLE ANATOMY IS CRITICAL. TWO clearly separate trouser legs run from hips
at ~y26 to flat planted boots at y37 of a 40px cell. No floor-length robes.
Visible elbow; near PRIMARY ARM on RIGHT bends FORWARD with an EMPTY sturdy
curled gripping fist at roughly native x24,y18. Upper arm, elbow, forearm at
least THREE native pixels thick. Negative space beneath forearm. Do not put
primary fist behind body or covered by gear. Rear accessories remain at LEFT.
Every character has hands but holds NO primary tool, weapon, staff, knife,
orb, lantern, hammer, torch, shield or sword. Runtime attaches signature tool
to the empty primary glove. Do not smuggle long weapon silhouettes into packs.

PALETTE: existing Emberdelve ink #141019, charcoal #2A2136, line #3A3148,
ash #9A8FA0 and #EDE6DA, ember #F08A2C, gold #E8C24A, blue #5B8DD9,
success green #6FBF73. Darker/desaturated tints and existing violet-grey allowed.
Each character needs a visibly DIFFERENT solid-black silhouette from the
others, matching a working underground-forge trade, not recoloured knights.

ROW 1: FLINTWRIGHT. Slight crouched flint knapper, short low triangular dust hood, wide flint-tan leather apron ending above knees, rear shard satchel shaped like a small squared pouch, wrapped sleeves and shins. Big glove on small body, muted GOLD/ash accents. No held pick or shards.

ROW 2: RUNESMITH. Tall narrow craftsperson, rectangular raised charcoal forge visor above pale face, one angular VIOLET-GREY collar plane, dark split leather apron and a single gold rectangular rune plaque on chest, rear belt chisel roll. Calm upright stance, no spell glow, floating rune, staff or held chisel.

ROW 3: BEARER. Largest and broadest worker in this group, low sloping shoulders with coarse ASH stone slab strapped to rear left under a thick crossed ochre load harness, small uncovered head, broad charcoal tunic, thick wrapped calves and widely planted iron boots. Strong but ordinary not superhero. No shield or object in hands.

ROW 4: MENDER. Slight figure with small rounded linen hood, sage-grey short tunic, crossed pale bandage straps, two clearly readable small rolled medical bundles at rear left belt, fitted dark trousers and cloth-wrapped boots. ASH and restrained SUCCESS GREEN accents. Not a cleric robe or plague mask. Empty glove ready at right, no staff or held awl.
scope: Owner-requested whole-playable-roster redesign; no gameplay changes.
